Maintenance during your lease

During the lease, the customer must keep the vehicle in good operating condition and complete scheduled maintenance in accordance with the owner's manual.

Routine service and consumables are the customer's responsibility and are not included in the monthly lease payment.

Before authorizing a repair expected to exceed $750, the customer must obtain written approval from the leasing company, except when immediate action is needed to address a safety emergency.

Any replacement parts installed must meet the vehicle manufacturer's specifications.
